title: Frame a biologically defensible prediction
intro: Turn scientific measurements into a prediction problem without splitting fields from the same animal across train/test or fitting preprocessing on the test set.

goals.title: Detect subject overlap and data leakage
goals.why: A model can memorize repeated experimental units if train and test share them.
explain: A valid holdout must have disjoint subject group IDs; duplicated fields or related acquisitions across sets violate independence.
Random field-level splits can produce apparently high accuracy even when there is zero transfer to unseen animals.
All numerical examples are synthetic. Cross-validation outputs alone do not validate prediction on new biological preparations.
